filter: app/etl_bdnb/transform.py transform_export(): members csv/rel_batiment_groupe_parcelle.csv and csv/batiment_groupe_ffo_bat.csv of each departemental zip, strict UTF-8 (a leading BOM stripped), values stripped, empty -> NULL; a relation without batiment_groupe_id or parcelle_id set aside (relations_ecartees), an ffo row without batiment_groupe_id dropped; parcelle_principale 1/0 and an integer year (smallint), else the file is refused; departement = file. pipeline.py swap() _TRANSFER_SQL: relations GROUP BY (parcelle_id, batiment_groupe_id) over EVERY file of the run, kept in the smallest code (COLLATE "C") with bool_or(parcelle_principale); ffo row of a group from its smallest code (then annee, mur, toit ascending, NULLS LAST); LEFT JOIN on the group. _DUPLICATES_SQL: doublons_inter_fichiers = pairs in more than one file, ffo_divergents = groups whose ffo rows carry more than one (annee, mur, toit), same file included; both attributed here to the departement of the kept row, their totals are the receipt counters. Exact for any number of files: K passes split by crc32 of batiment_groupe_id (pairs and join) and of parcelle_id (parcelles_distinctes)
